replacements.new: /* Native C uses the original byte-copy path for every length. */
replacements.reason: Do not expose the MSL header directory globally, where it would shadow host string, math, stdio, and type headers. The only declarations in mem_funcs.h belong to the removed Metrowerks-only long-copy path; memchr and memcmp remain unchanged.

Run MSL's own overlap-direction byte-copy loop for every length on native C. Metrowerks' 32-byte optimization helpers rely on assignable cast expressions that standard C does not support, and their non-Metrowerks bodies are empty. The retained loop produces the same destination bytes and return pointer for aligned, unaligned, overlapping, and non-overlapping ranges without host libc substitution.
